summary: Centrus Energy Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a seventh amendment to its Section 382 Rights Agreement (poison pill). The amendment extends the expiration date from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2029 and increases the purchase price per 1/1000th of a preferred share from $160.38 to $1,143.95, reflecting the rise in the common stock trading price since the fifth amendment. The board approved the amendment on March 10, 2026, and stockholders ratified it at the annual meeting on June 18, 2026. The amendment is intended to preserve net operating loss carry-forwards and was not adopted in response to any acquisition effort. This is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation.
